read_this_first: Rows are only comparable within the same media_class and the same tenant conditions.
class A media = HEVC Main 10 >= 8128x4288, 29.97-class rate, 3840x1520 timeline (see bench/resolve-agentic/MEDIA.md).
Render ms are single-tenant; two-agent waves inflate them (a 7285 ms T7 render ran alongside another agent's Fusion work).
Every number here came from an independent read-back (ffprobe / item geometry / server operation log), never from the agent's report.
